title: Voice, visibility, and auto-setting usability issues
summary: This topic groups several unrelated usability complaints, including voice interaction limits, hard-to-read or hard-to-handle controls, and configuration issues such as auto settings.

positive.summary: One positive review notes a small component above the mirror is hard to grip, but the supplied sample does not provide enough context to identify the praised aspect clearly.

negative.summary: One negative review criticizes the car's inability to support Danish voice commands.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention several separate issues, including unreadable displays, clock auto-mode setup, phone conversations with high fan noise, weak trunk hooks, unexplained new-car behavior, and headlight auto settings without enough context for clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects rather than one coherent issue.
Most examples are undetermined or too short to support a clear sentiment reading.
The positive example appears complaint-like, so the supplied sentiment label may limit interpretation.
Because the sample is sentiment-stratified and small, it should not be treated as representative of all G60 feedback on this topic.
